data.text: Delhi: Ongoing sewer line construction near Nawada Metro Station has caused major inconvenience for local residents and daily commuters. Excavation work has been underway for the past five days, and the administration has issued a 45-day traffic advisory, indicating prolonged disruption ahead. Residents have urged authorities to speed up the work and improve traffic management to ease the congestion and provide relief to commuters
